registration.title: Complete attendee registration
registration.description: Register attendees through the public event QR API. The page uses the configured event/place QR code and sends only attendee fields in the request body.

form.title: Registration form
form.description: Required fields match the public registration contract used by the event QR scan page.

validation.phoneNumber: Phone number must be at least 8 digits.
validation.emailRequired: Email is required when delivery method is email.
validation.profileImageUrl: Use a valid profile image URL.

download.title: Download
download.text: The API returns the high quality QR image. Show the QR preview and provide a direct image download.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.text: The API can return a Telegram bot URL. Open it so the attendee can link their QR delivery.

email.title: Email
email.text: The API sends the QR/card to the attendee email and returns email delivery status.

result.emptyDescription: After registration, QR delivery details will appear here.
result.telegramPending: Telegram delivery was requested. The API did not return a bot link in this response.
result.emailSent: The QR card was sent to the attendee email.
result.emailPending: Email delivery was requested. Check the API delivery status above.
